verdict.rationale: Orrick has a dedicated Trademark, Copyright & Media practice page stating the team "manages thousands of trademarks for hundreds of clients" from startups to large companies. That is a documented standalone team handling trademark portfolios, which implies registration and maintenance. The evidence excerpts never explicitly describe clearance searches or brand enforcement actions; the litigation credentials cited are copyright cases, not trademark enforcement. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of trademark clearance/search services, explicit trademark enforcement or anti-counterfeiting work, independent corroboration.
